title: Agreeing on a version
description:
Let a client and server agree on a protocol version when they connect.

```
client supports 1-3, server supports 2-4 -> use 3
client supports 1-1, server supports 2-4 -> no common version
```
hints: The common range is `max(lows)` to `min(highs)`; it is empty when the first is bigger (lesson 5.02).
Send the versions first, before anything else, so every future version can still read them.
requirements: Each side sends its lowest and highest version.
The chosen version is the highest both support, or an error.
Print the handshake messages both ways.
stretch: Add optional features as flags both sides must agree on.
